#!/bin/bash

# Diagnostic Collection Script
# Logs CPU usage, memory state, and disk health status

set -e

TIMESTAMP=$(date '+%Y-%m-%d_%H-%M-%S')
DIAGNOSTICS_DIR="/tmp/mcp-workspace/diagnostics"
REPORT_FILE="${DIAGNOSTICS_DIR}/diagnostics_${TIMESTAMP}.log"

# Create diagnostics directory if it doesn't exist
mkdir -p "${DIAGNOSTICS_DIR}"

echo "========================================" | tee "${REPORT_FILE}"
echo "System Diagnostics Report" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
echo "Generated: $(date)" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
echo "========================================" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
echo "" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"

# CPU Usage Information
echo "--- CPU USAGE ---" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
echo "CPU Information:" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
nproc 2>/dev/null | xargs -I {} echo "Number of CPUs: {}" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
echo "" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"

echo "Current CPU Usage (top 5 processes):" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
ps aux --sort=-%cpu | head -6 | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
echo "" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"

echo "Average Load:" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
uptime | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
echo "" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"

# Memory State Information
echo "--- MEMORY STATE ---" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
echo "Memory Information:" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
free -h | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
echo "" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"

echo "Memory Usage (top 5 processes):" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
ps aux --sort=-%mem | head -6 | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
echo "" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"

# Disk Health Status
echo "--- DISK HEALTH STATUS ---" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
echo "Disk Space Usage:" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
df -h | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
echo "" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"

echo "Disk Inode Usage:" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
df -i | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
echo "" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"

# Check for disk errors if smartctl is available
if command -v smartctl &> /dev/null; then
    echo "SMART Disk Status:" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
    for disk in $(lsblk -d -n -o NAME | grep -E '^(sd|nvme)'); do
        echo "Checking /dev/${disk}..." | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
        smartctl -H "/dev/${disk}" 2>/dev/null || echo "  (SMART not available for this disk)" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
    done
else
    echo "smartctl not available - SMART status check skipped" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
fi
echo "" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"

# Filesystem Check
echo "Filesystem Status:" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
mount | grep -E '(ext4|xfs|btrfs|ntfs)' | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
echo "" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"

# Summary
echo "========================================" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
echo "Diagnostics collection completed successfully" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
echo "Report saved to: ${REPORT_FILE}" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"
echo "========================================" | tee -a "${REPORT_FILE}"

exit 0
